name: Tire shop

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: 4 new tires, installed
services.story: The main story: 4 new tires for Alex's size, ordered in: $868 installed, with road-hazard protection. A $100 deposit is taken once Sam OKs and orders them, credited to the bill. Alex waits about an hour and pays the $768 rest at the counter.

services.name: Flat repair
services.story: A $35 flat repair, or tires already on the rack: nothing is taken, and a YES books the bay. Alex waits and pays at the counter.

services.name: Flat repair
services.story: The $35 flat repair with the car left at the shop. Rosie texts the bill with READY, so Alex can pay before pick-up.

services.name: 4 new tires, installed
services.story: The 4 ordered tires, with the car left at the shop. The $768 rest is on the bill Rosie texts with READY.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Seasonal tire swap
services.story: The main story: a $179 seasonal swap in Alex's driveway. The winter tires, already on their own wheels, go on. A card is saved for the $89 trip fee, and Rosie texts the bill after Diego texts DONE.

services.name: 4 new tires, fitted at home
services.story: 4 new tires ordered in for Alex's size and fitted at home: $885 with the trip fee. A $100 deposit is taken once Sam OKs the order; the rest is on the bill after DONE.
